get.summary: Lists accounts, 25 per page by default.

post.summary: Creates an account with a temporary password the person must change at first sign-in.
Disables an account and signs it out everywhere.
Sets a new temporary password (shown once) and signs the person out everywhere.
Unlocks a locked account, or re-enables a disabled one.

get.summary: Who did what and when, newest first.

post.summary: Asks for a reset link. The answer is always the same, so nobody can discover which e-mails exist.
Signs a user in with e-mail and password.

200.description: Signed in. The refresh token is set as an HttpOnly cookie.

403.description: Account locked or disabled (code account_locked / account_disabled)

post.summary: Ends the session. Always answers 204, even if the cookie was already invalid.

204.description: Signed out; the refresh cookie is deleted

post.summary: Swaps the refresh cookie for a new one and returns a fresh access token.

200.description: New access token; the refresh cookie is replaced

post.summary: Sets a new password using the link from the e-mail.

200.description: Password changed; all sessions were signed out

400.description: Link invalid or expired, or password too weak

get.summary:
Liveness plus a database check. Used by monitoring and the frontend start page.
Returns 503 when the database does not answer so load balancers stop sending traffic.
Who am I and what may I do? Called by the frontend after sign-in and after a page reload.

put.summary: Changes the password and signs out every other device. Returns a fresh session for this one.

400.description: Current password wrong, or new password too weak

next_before_id.description: Pass this as `before_id` to get the next page. Absent on the last page.

HealthResponse.description: Result of the health check. `database` is `"ok"` or `"down"`.

remember.description: "Keep me signed in": the refresh cookie lasts days instead of the browser session.

MeResponse.description: Who the signed-in user is and what they may do.

SessionResponse.description:
Returned by login, refresh and change-password. The refresh token travels separately, in an
`HttpOnly` cookie that scripts cannot read.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

TemporaryPasswordResponse.description: Returned once. The temporary password cannot be shown again.
